api_endpoints.purpose: Accept a url and an optional title, store the link, and return the stored record including its generated id and created_at timestamp.
api_endpoints.note: The description states a POST endpoint that accepts a URL and an optional title. The method and behaviour are stated; the path string is not stated in the feature and is inferred from the Link entity name.

acceptance_criteria.text: When a link is posted with a url and a title, the system shall store it and return 201 with an integer id, the submitted url and title, and a created_at timestamp.
When a link is posted with a url and no title, the system shall store it with a null title and return 201.
If a link is posted with no url field, then the system shall return 422 and store nothing.
If a link is posted with a url that does not parse as an absolute http or https URL, then the system shall return 422 and store nothing.
